what_works: Three-step process section uses generous whitespace and a single transparent pricing block — 'no upsell language' confidence reads exactly the way a sophisticated homeowner wants a contractor to read. Logo-strip social proof in muted greys rather than rainbow brand colors.
what_does_not_translate: Agency-style 'the one you stop searching after' copy is too cute for a trade; keep the silent-confidence layout, write plain service language.
type_observations: Single neutral grotesk (Inter / Aeonik feel) at three sizes; no italic, no bold flourishes — hierarchy is purely scale and color.
